title: HPictorialChartComponent
description: Renders real/pictorial charts using step image sequences or dynamic clipped layers

sourceConnectorName.title: Input connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Optional data connector feeding this component

seriesName.title: Pictorial series
seriesName.description: Name of a reusable pictorial-series metadata element (image steps or empty/fill layers under ${HOPPER_METADATA_PATH}/assets/pictorial-series/{name}/)

renderMode.title: Render mode
renderMode.description: STEP_IMAGES for discrete multi-image mapping or CLIPPED_LAYERS for dynamic fill clipping

categoryColumn.title: Category column (horizontal)
categoryColumn.description: Connector field for each pictorial cell (bar-chart style). Empty = single first-row gauge.

valueColumn.title: Value column
valueColumn.description: Name of the connector field providing the metric value

showCategoryLabel.title: Show category label?
showCategoryLabel.description: Draw category name below each image

stepQuantization.title: Step quantization
stepQuantization.description: Quantization strategy for STEP_IMAGES mode (NEAREST, FLOOR, CEIL)

imageMap.title: Image map
imageMap.description: Map of percentage thresholds (e.g. '0', '50', '100') to image file paths

backgroundImage.title: Background image (empty container)
backgroundImage.description: Path to the empty/background container image for CLIPPED_LAYERS mode

fillImage.title: Fill image (full container)
fillImage.description: Path to the full fill container image for CLIPPED_LAYERS mode

showValueLabel.title: Show value label?
showValueLabel.description: Draw a text label displaying the evaluated metric value

labelFormat.title: Value label format
labelFormat.description: Format string for the metric value (e.g. %.1f%%)
